text: FOL ::: ∀x (Tsunami(x) → (UnderwaterEarthquakes(x) ∨ VolcanicEruptions(x) ∨ Landslides(x)) ∧ CausesMassiveWaves(x) ∧ DevastatesCoastalAreas(x)) ::: A tsunami can be triggered by underwater earthquakes, volcanic eruptions, or landslides, causing a series of massive waves that devastate coastal areas.
